history.summary: Sandy Eight is a freehold boutique 1BR (506 sqft) in D15 near Paya Lebar, $980K / $1,937 psf — slightly above the $1,899 median, on only 6 URA transactions making the ~5.1% rate unreliable. The lowest Elo in the batch (836) and a 70-241 record flag this as a weak, illiquid boutique shoebox.
history.rating_rationale: Only 6 URA txns — the ~5.1% CAGR is statistically meaningless. Listed $1,937 psf is above the $1,899 median (no value cushion). Sandy Eight is a small boutique block (very low Elo 836, 70-241 record reflects persistent competitive weakness), and a 506 sqft freehold shoebox in a no-facilities boutique is hard to exit. 10-min/840m MRT walk removes transit appeal. Missing built_year too.
red_flags: Only 6 URA txns — appreciation rate unreliable
Listed PSF above district median — no value cushion
Boutique shoebox, lowest Elo in batch (836) — structurally illiquid
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central commercial growth in the broader vicinity

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Modest — boutique 1BR away from the MRT has weaker tenant pull than larger condos; yield ~3-3.5%.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Cannot trust the 6-txn ~5.1% rate; boutique illiquidity and above-median pricing argue for flat-to-market appreciation with exit risk.
